searchText: I see that you are using an old version of besu on this node . could you confirm ? caa5abf could you try with this one 3013b7a0d62c348a1d18ed706e4cb085cdae3270 is it something you can reproduce ? it will be nice to see if can have the same issue again with a big reorg I was checking at the logs of this node it seems it had a lot of this kind of issues since a long time . i is the nimbus version has a specific behavior on this instance ? I see that this node is spammed with sendRawTransaction, eth_gasPrice , getTransactionReceipt etc is it nornal ? could you also add this flags in order to limit the impact of the RPC calls > --cache-last-blocks=2048 --rpc-http-max-active-connections=1000 ah ok I got it I think it is the old fix I added for the nimbus FCU behavior that we forgot to completely remove on this branch I will add a new commit to fix that. A resync will be better to be sure we are in a good state . you can now use this commit in all the nodes 5140ab39d29d05d6de8bea74664f335ee16d9977 we recommand also to use this flags as the nodes are receiving a lot of RPC requests > --cache-last-blocks=2048 --rpc-http-max-active-connections=1000 I created the PR https://github.com/ethpandaops/glamsterdam-devnets/pull/60, <@412614104222531604> for review 🙏🏼 I'm a bit confused how any of this could lead to fake invalid it is not linked to the flag, it is linked to an issue in the code I removed in the last commit
